display.description: Temporal SDK metrics scraped from thanos:8080/metrics. Filters: namespace, org_id, workflow_type, task_queue, worker_type. NOTE: org_id is NOT on temporal_* metrics today — filter/groupBy is wired for the moment thanos ships refold_workflow_* with org_id. Latency shown as rate(_sum)+rate(_count); percentiles land in a follow-up (builder cannot express histogram_quantile).
